messages.subject: Vault Birmingham - strategy before LBA
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Elena,

Now we have the LFA report, a few thoughts before we send the letter of claim:

1. Plead the full £3.42m. Ventilation and water-treatment are our strongest heads; water ingress is good but Hartwell will run the 'your consultant's design' point - we need the design responsibility matrix.
2. Loss of profit (£1.31m) is the exposed head. We should line up a forensic accountant before trial to support the membership model.
3. Watch the Schedule 7 liability cap - I want counsel's view on whether it bites on the design obligations.

Let's get Catherine Rosenthal KC instructed for an early advice on merits and quantum.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield

T +44 20 7946 0102
